summary: The Radiant Seat: the largest Sunhot realm, which chairs the Noon Council, guards Gala and keeps a long quiet border with the East.

radiant_speaker.name: The Radiant Speaker
radiant_speaker.desc: Soyan wears a robe the colour of morning and chairs the Council from a seat of pale stone. The Speakers of the other realms address her as the Radiant, and she answers each by name.

light_over_valleys.name: Light Over Every Valley
light_over_valleys.desc: Beacons on the hills carry the Speaker's greeting from one valley to the next at dawn. No settlement in the Lands of Light is further than a day from a lamp-keeper.

one_voice.name: One Voice at Noon
one_voice.desc: A verdict of the Council is spoken in one voice, and the realms act on it as on a single command. Envoys of other courts say they have never heard so large a hall sound so certain.

first_among_sun_realms.name: First Among the Sun Realms
first_among_sun_realms.desc: Speakers of the other realms begin their letters with the name of the Lands of Light and end them by asking its view. It leads by being asked, and has never once had to command.

sun_guard.name: The Sun Guard
sun_guard.desc: A few hundred very tall spearmen stand in white and gold at the Council's gates, and they have not fought in living memory. For Sunhot elves, that is a long time.

sun_guard_rides.name: The Sun Guard Rides
sun_guard_rides.desc: The Guard has left its gates for the roads. White banners go out with the spearmen, and the valleys they pass turn out to watch in silence.

eastern_watch.name: Watch on the East
eastern_watch.desc: Signal-posts and spear-companies line the eastern ridge, and a rider sleeps beside every beacon. The Lands of Light has no quarrel with its neighbours, and will not be surprised by them.

the_council_meets.title: The Council Meets
the_council_meets.desc: The Speakers of the Sunhot realms gather at noon in the white hall, under a roof open to the sky. The Radiant Speaker asks what the Council should speak of first, and the other Speakers wait with folded hands.

options.name: Ask the King of Gala's counsel

focuses.name: The Radiant Seat
focuses.desc: Fifteen states of bright valleys, white-stone towns and long roads reach from the Sea of Gods to the edge of the East. The Radiant Speaker presides over all of them, and over the Noon Council besides.

focuses.name: The Radiant Speaker
focuses.desc: Soyan holds the Radiant Seat by the custom of the Council, not by the right of birth. She is old for a human and young for an elf, and she is listened to by both.

focuses.name: The Bright Roads
focuses.desc: Wide roads of pale stone link every valley, with milestones carved in the old tongue and benches at every bend. A rider can cross the realm in a week and meet no one he does not know.

focuses.name: Halls of Light
focuses.desc: Tall halls of glass and white stone rise in the largest towns, each with a lamp that is never put out. The Speaker's seal is cut into every lintel.

focuses.name: The Long Noon
focuses.desc: The noon hour is kept as a rest in every town, with the shutters closed and the markets silent. Quarrels are said to be harder to start after a quiet hour.

focuses.name: Light Over Every Valley
focuses.desc: A chain of beacons carries the Speaker's morning greeting from hill to hill. Every town replies in its turn, and the whole realm hears itself speak.

focuses.name: The Chair of Noon
focuses.desc: When the Noon Council meets, the Radiant Speaker takes the chair. She calls the hours, hears the quarrels and sums the verdict in one sentence.

focuses.name: The Council Meets
focuses.desc: The Speakers gather in the white hall at noon, and the chair opens the day with a silence. What they decide will be heard in every Sunhot court by nightfall.

focuses.name: A Guest From Gala
focuses.desc: The King of Gala attends the Council as an honoured guest, with no vote and no chair. When he speaks, the hall falls silent to hear him.

focuses.name: Judges of Quarrels
focuses.desc: The chair hears the old quarrels of the Sunhot realms, one at a time, and judges them without anger. Merchants who have feuded for a century find themselves shaking hands.

focuses.name: One Voice at Noon
focuses.desc: When the Council agrees, its Speakers speak the verdict together, one sentence from fifteen mouths. Nobody who hears it has doubted that it was meant.

focuses.name: The Noon Charter
focuses.desc: The customs of the Council are written down at last, in a tall book bound in white leather. It is read at the opening of every session and has never been disputed.

focuses.name: Raise the Noon League
focuses.desc: If danger comes, the Council will bind its realms into a league of mutual defence. The chair must judge whether the Speakers are of one mind, and whether the danger is near enough.

else.tooltip: The realms are not yet of one mind.

focuses.name: First Among the Sun Realms
focuses.desc: The Lands of Light does not command its neighbours and does not need to. Their Speakers begin each letter with its name.

focuses.name: The Sun Guard
focuses.desc: The Guard is a few hundred very tall spearmen in white and gold, who stand at the Council's gates and have not fought in living memory. For Sunhot elves, that is a long time.

focuses.name: The Tall Spears
focuses.desc: The Guard's spears are cut from ash and are longer than any in the East. Their points are leaf-shaped and their shafts are carved with the names of those who carried them.

focuses.name: Ballistae of the Sun
focuses.desc: Great bows on wheeled frames are built to stand on the white walls. Their bolts are as long as a man, and their crews are as patient as stones.

focuses.name: Watch Over Gala
focuses.desc: If Gala is threatened, the Guard's captains want to be ready. A company is posted on the road to the north-west, and a lamp is kept burning in their watch-tower.

focuses.name: The Guard Drills
focuses.desc: The spearmen drill on the great green below the hall, and the sound of their shields carries across three valleys. Young captains learn in a season what once took a lifetime.

focuses.name: The Sun Guard Rides
focuses.desc: At the Council's word the Guard leaves its gates for the roads, banners flying and spears raised. The valleys it passes turn out in silence to watch.

focuses.name: The Eastern Border
focuses.desc: The valleys of the Lands of Light end where the eastern courts begin, at a ridge of red stone and thorn. The Speaker sends a surveyor to mark the line.

effects.tooltip: Our valleys end where the eastern courts begin.

focuses.name: Traders From Alerhia
focuses.desc: Alerhia's caravans come over the red ridge each spring, with dyed cloth, salt and tales. The Lands of Light buys cloth and sells fruit, and nobody argues about the price.

focuses.name: The Passes of Miaed
focuses.desc: Miaed's wardens keep the high gates to the south-east, and their lord is courteous and watchful. A pact of quiet is exchanged across the ridge.

focuses.name: Border Forts of Light
focuses.desc: The ridge is crowned with white forts that look inward toward the valleys and outward toward the passes. Their garrisons are drawn from the Guard.

focuses.name: Watch the Rift War
focuses.desc: Riders are sent to the eastern courts to learn what the host is doing, and what it intends. The Lands of Light is at peace, and wishes to remain so.

focuses.name: No Eastern Banner Here
focuses.desc: A white banner is raised on every eastern ridge, and the Speaker's word goes to the courts beyond: no host will cross unquestioned. The Council's realms take heart.
